correctness.rationale: The exact Cartesian edge signatures d((b,k),R_j)=1-[k=j] and d((b,k),H_{a,X})=1-[k∈X]+[b≠a] distinguish all edge types. Two missing columns force indistinguishable rungs, giving ≥n-1 landmarks. At equality, one hole and one landmark in each other column are forced. Rung/horizontal collisions rule out <3 selected on either side, and four edge-pair cases prove sufficiency for ≥3 each. An entire clique layer gives n landmarks for n=2..6. The mobility proof is constructive: horizontal slide into the hole relocates it, three horizontal slides interchange opposite-colour occupied columns without violating counts, and vertical matching slides connect allowable layer populations. At n=7 exactly 140 states and each has six horizontal moves. Independent exhaustive edge-distance and BFS slide checks confirmed all n=2..7 cases and n=7 connectivity; the all-n result rests on the constructive argument.
